infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Astra Vault uses the camera for meteor and event capture. Captures are time-synced and geotagged to cross-reference with professional astronomy networks (CAMS).
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Astra Vault uses the microphone for voice-trigger meteor capture (say "METEOR" to capture without looking at the screen).
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Astra Vault uses your location to compute visible objects, observing conditions, and to cross-reference your meteor sightings with professional networks.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Astra Vault uses location during active observation sessions for meteor cross-referencing and event tracking.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Astra Vault uses motion sensors to determine where your phone is pointed for sky alignment and capture orientation.

plugins.cameraPermission: Astra Vault uses the camera to capture meteor and event frames. Captures are time-synced and geotagged for cross-reference with professional astronomy networks.
